== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}
{{Migrating Ancestor|origin= Ireland |destination= New Zealand|origin-flag= Flags-1.gif |destination-flag= Flags-19.png}}
Thomas was born about 1832-1836. He was the son of [[Glasgow-2054|Samuel Glasgow]] and [[McCormick-8286|Ann McCormick]]. 
<ref name="d"/>

He was Confirmed at Derryloran parish church in 1846, aged 14.5 years, resident of Gortin (near Cookstown).
<ref>[[Space:The_Parish_Registers_of_Derryloran_parish_church|The Parish Registers of Derryloran parish church]] - Vol2</ref>

He was in New Zealand by 1875, working as a miner at Thames.
<ref>PapersPast search "Thomas M. Glasgow" -- various results.</ref>

He passed away 2 May 1913 at 15 South Street, Auckland.
<ref name="d">NZ BDM Death registration: 1913/2793	Glasgow	Thomas McNeice	77Y . {{Ancestry Tree Media|108104612|606ec24e-8c7f-4e70-a9c6-422b9427251f}} full image.</ref>
He was intestate and nobody took out administration of the estate.
<ref>{{Archives New Zealand|R22219454}} GLASGOW, Thomas McNeice, 1913 probate file, Wellington repository.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2054]] is assessed at 99% (proved). Thomas's retained NZ death-certificate transcription explicitly names Samuel and Annie formerly McCormick. Gortin confirmation and Letitia's shared locality identify this couple despite his variable birth estimates.

Selected Glasgow-2054 fatherhood of Glasgow-2538; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare the certificate with the Gortin confirmation original.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2538 NZ BDM Death registration: 1913/2793 Glasgow Thomas McNeice 77Y . full image.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


Transcription of NZ death certificate:
* d. 2 May 1913 at 15 South Street, Auckland.
* Thomas McNeice Glasgow, retired mine manager, age 77.
* Prostatis & chronic cystitis; senile exhaustion.
* Parents: Samuel Glasgow + Annie Glasgow formerly McCormick; land owner.
* Buried at Waikaraka.
* Born Cookstown Ireland.

Gortin was a small townland; it seems likely that the Confirmation record 1846 is the same person, therefore he would have been born 1831 or 1832.  Letitia is also in the same confirmation register , age 15 in 1843.

It seems more likely to me that the age at death would have been a few years off -- death ages, especially for Irish of this time period, were often very inaccurate.
 
Possible passenger log: Thomas Glasgow (24) + Martha J. Glasgow (16) both Irish, arrive in Victoria, Australia in 1858 aboard the ''Africa''.
